items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Yeah Johnny Sincere was playing with me. He was playing guitar with me.

ctx.x: from Johnny Sincere. Johnny Sincere played, when he came back from playing with Louis he came right there and played with me. Well he did was he? Yeah Johnny Sincere was playing with me. He was playing guitar with me. Yeah. He's going back California. Yes he's. He came here, built a home, stayed there and he played out all around. Then he turned around, made up his mind, go back, sold the home and went back to California.
It looks like a fest isn't going to come today. I wanted to ask did you ever play with Professor Mineta?
